title: Operator UI: browser is renderer and intent source, never trading authority
summary: Wire UI defines visible semantics, Wire UI Server controls exact-revision action availability, the VMM application adapter resolves server-owned selection/state, and only existing VMM domain/Queue Fabric authority performs transitions.
invariants: A visible button is not authority.
Browser-supplied order ID, quantity or price cannot replace server-selected order economics.
Cancel uses the real VMM order/correlation/remaining quantity and becomes CANCEL_PENDING when routed.
Operator reconciliation remains unavailable until a real VMM reconciliation-request command exists.
Strategy disable/resume is not the same as the firm-wide kill switch.

provenance.claim: Wire UI Builder/Server/VMM adapter/domain authority layers and browser non-authority.
Exact @3 release identity and server/VMM adapter authority regressions.
